basic_profile.bio: Avid hiker and music enthusiast residing in Portland, Oregon. I spend my weekends exploring the Pacific Crest Trail while weekdays are reserved for my job as a freelance graphic designer. My evenings are mostly spent online, usually between 7 PM and midnight. Single and enjoying the freedom to travel and discover new music. I've been collecting rare live recordings of my favorite bands, especially those from the 90s. Not a fan of digital-only releases; there's something special about physical media.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in graphic design with a background in visual arts from community college. Developed a keen interest in music history, particularly in the evolution of live performances and bootleg recordings. Extensive experience in hiking and outdoor survival skills, gained through years of trekking various trails across the US.
